// 4. Enhanced UI Components

/**
 * @interface ComplianceCaseFormProps
 * @description Props for the ComplianceCaseForm component.
 */
export interface ComplianceCaseFormProps {
    initialCase?: ComplianceCaseExtended;
    onSave: (caseData: ComplianceCaseExtended) => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
    isLoading: boolean;
}

/**
 * @function ComplianceCaseForm
 * @description A form for creating or editing compliance cases.
 */
export const ComplianceCaseForm: React.FC<ComplianceCaseFormProps> = ({ initialCase, onSave, onCancel, isLoading }) => {
    const isEditing = !!initialCase;
    const { formData, handleChange, setFormData } = useForm<Partial<ComplianceCaseExtended>>(initialCase || {
        caseNumber: '',
        reason: '',
        entityId: '',
        entityType: '',
        status: 'Open',
        priority: RiskLevel.Medium,
        description: '',
        detectionDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        dueDate: new Date(new Date().setDate(new Date().getDate() + 30)).toISOString().split('T')[0],
        assignedTo: mockCurrentUser.name,
        involvedEntities: [],
        evidenceDocuments: [],
        actionItems: [],
        auditLog: [],
    });
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

    const validate = useCallback(() => {
        const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
        if (!formData.reason || formData.reason.trim() === '') newErrors.reason = 'Reason is required.';
        if (!formData.entityId || formData.entityId.trim() === '') newErrors.entityId = 'Entity ID is required.';
        if (!formData.entityType || formData.entityType.trim() === '') newErrors.entityType = 'Entity Type is required.';
        if (!formData.description || formData.description.trim() === '') newErrors.description = 'Description is required.';
        if (!formData.dueDate || formData.dueDate < formData.detectionDate!) newErrors.dueDate = 'Due date cannot be before detection date.';
        setErrors(newErrors);
        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
    }, [formData]);

    const handleSubmit = useCallback((e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!validate()) return;

        const caseToSave: ComplianceCaseExtended = {
            ...(initialCase || {}),
            id: initialCase?.id || generateUUID(),
            caseNumber: initialCase?.caseNumber || `COMP-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${generateUUID().substring(0, 5).toUpperCase()}`,
            openedDate: (initialCase?.openedDate || new Date().toISOString()).split('T')[0],
            ...formData,
            status: formData.status || 'Open',
            priority: formData.priority || RiskLevel.Medium,
            detectionDate: formData.detectionDate || new Date().toISOString(),
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
            assignedTo: formData.assignedTo || mockCurrentUser.name,
            involvedEntities: formData.involvedEntities || [],
            evidenceDocuments: formData.evidenceDocuments || [],
            actionItems: formData.actionItems || [],
            auditLog: initialCase?.auditLog || [], // Audit log handled by service
        } as ComplianceCaseExtended; // Type assertion as partial form might not cover all fields

        onSave(caseToSave);
    }, [formData, initialCase, onSave, validate]);

    const statusOptions = useMemo(() => Object.values(ComplianceCaseExtended['status']).map(s => ({ value: s, label: s })), []);
    const priorityOptions = useMemo(() => Object.values(RiskLevel).map(p => ({ value: p, label: p })), []);
    const entityTypeOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'Transaction', label: 'Transaction' },
        { value: 'Account', label: 'Account' },
        { value: 'User', label: 'User' },
        { value: 'Vendor', label: 'Vendor' },
        { value: 'Policy', label: 'Policy' },
        { value: 'System', label: 'System' },
        { value: 'Other', label: 'Other' },
    ]), []);
    const assignedToOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'Compliance Officer A', label: 'Compliance Officer A' },
        { value: 'Analyst B', label: 'Analyst B' },
        { value: 'Legal Counsel C', label: 'Legal Counsel C' },
        { value: 'Risk Analyst D', label: 'Risk Analyst D' },
    ]), []);

    return (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <InputField label="Case Number" id="caseNumber" value={formData.caseNumber || ''} readOnly={true} />
                <InputField label="Reason" id="reason" value={formData.reason || ''} onChange={handleChange} required error={errors.reason} />
                <InputField label="Entity ID" id="entityId" value={formData.entityId || ''} onChange={handleChange} required error={errors.entityId} />
                <FilterSelect<string>
                    label="Entity Type"
                    options={entityTypeOptions}
                    selectedValue={formData.entityType || ''}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, entityType: val || '' }))}
                    allowClear={false}
                />
                <FilterSelect<ComplianceCaseExtended['status']>
                    label="Status"
                    options={statusOptions}
                    selectedValue={formData.status || 'Open'}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, status: val || 'Open' }))}
                    allowClear={false}
                />
                <FilterSelect<RiskLevel>
                    label="Priority"
                    options={priorityOptions}
                    selectedValue={formData.priority || RiskLevel.Medium}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, priority: val || RiskLevel.Medium }))}
                    allowClear={false}
                />
                <InputField label="Detection Date" id="detectionDate" type="date" value={formData.detectionDate?.split('T')[0] || ''} onChange={handleChange} />
                <InputField label="Due Date" id="dueDate" type="date" value={formData.dueDate?.split('T')[0] || ''} onChange={handleChange} required error={errors.dueDate} />
                <FilterSelect<string>
                    label="Assigned To"
                    options={assignedToOptions}
                    selectedValue={formData.assignedTo || ''}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, assignedTo: val || '' }))}
                    allowClear={true}
                />
            </div>
            <InputField label="Description" id="description" value={formData.description || ''} onChange={handleChange} multiline rows={3} required error={errors.description} />
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel} disabled={isLoading}>Cancel</Button>
                <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={isLoading}>
                    {isLoading ? 'Saving...' : (isEditing ? 'Update Case' : 'Create Case')}
                </Button>
            </div>
        </form>
    );
};

/**
 * @interface ComplianceCaseDetailModalProps
 * @description Props for the ComplianceCaseDetailModal component.
 */
export interface ComplianceCaseDetailModalProps {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    caseId: string;
    onEdit: (caseData: ComplianceCaseExtended) => void;
    onDelete: (caseId: string) => void;
    onStatusChange: (caseId: string, newStatus: ComplianceCaseExtended['status']) => void;
    onActionItemUpdate: (caseId: string, updatedActionItem: ActionItem) => void;
}

/**
 * @function ComplianceCaseDetailModal
 * @description Displays a comprehensive detail view of a single compliance case.
 */
export const ComplianceCaseDetailModal: React.FC<ComplianceCaseDetailModalProps> = ({
    isOpen, onClose, caseId, onEdit, onDelete, onStatusChange, onActionItemUpdate
}) => {
    const [complianceCase, setComplianceCase] = useState<ComplianceCaseExtended | null>(null);
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'actionItems' | 'evidence' | 'auditLog' | 'resolution'>('overview');
    const [isConfirmDeleteModalOpen, setIsConfirmDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [isEditModalOpen, setIsEditModalOpen] = useState(false);

    const fetchCaseDetails = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!caseId) return;
        setIsLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.getComplianceCaseById(caseId);
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setComplianceCase(result.data);
            } else {
                setError(result.error || 'Failed to fetch case details.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [caseId]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isOpen && caseId) {
            fetchCaseDetails();
        }
    }, [isOpen, caseId, fetchCaseDetails]);

    const handleSaveCase = useCallback(async (updatedCase: ComplianceCaseExtended) => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.updateComplianceCase(updatedCase.id, updatedCase);
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setComplianceCase(result.data);
                onEdit(result.data);
                setIsEditModalOpen(false);
            } else {
                throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to update case.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [onEdit]);

    const handleDeleteCase = useCallback(async () => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.deleteComplianceCase(caseId);
            if (result.success) {
                onDelete(caseId);
                onClose();
            } else {
                throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to delete case.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [caseId, onDelete, onClose]);

    const handleUpdateStatus = useCallback(async (newStatus: ComplianceCaseExtended['status']) => {
        if (!complianceCase) return;
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.updateComplianceCase(complianceCase.id, { status: newStatus });
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setComplianceCase(result.data);
                onStatusChange(result.data.id, result.data.status);
            } else {
                throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to update status.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [complianceCase, onStatusChange]);

    if (!isOpen) return null;

    return (
        <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title={`Compliance Case: ${complianceCase?.caseNumber || 'N/A'}`} size="xl">
            {isLoading ? (
                <LoadingSpinner />
            ) : error ? (
                <p className="text-red-400 text-center">{error}</p>
            ) : complianceCase ? (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mb-4">
                        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setIsEditModalOpen(true)}>
                            <PencilSquareIcon className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /> Edit
                        </Button>
                        <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => setIsConfirmDeleteModalOpen(true)}>
                            <TrashIcon className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /> Delete
                        </Button>
                    </div>

                    <div className="border-b border-gray-700">
                        <nav className="flex space-x-4 p-4">
                            {['overview', 'actionItems', 'evidence', 'auditLog', 'resolution'].map(tab => (
                                <button
                                    key={tab}
                                    className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors duration-200
                                        ${activeTab === tab ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700 hover:text-white'}
                                    `}
                                    onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab as any)}
                                >
                                    {tab.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + tab.slice(1).replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')}
                                </button>
                            ))}
                        </nav>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex-grow p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                        {activeTab === 'overview' && <ComplianceOverviewTab complianceCase={complianceCase} onStatusChange={handleUpdateStatus} />}
                        {activeTab === 'actionItems' && <ComplianceActionItemsTab caseId={complianceCase.id} actionItems={complianceCase.actionItems} onActionItemUpdate={onActionItemUpdate} />}
                        {activeTab === 'evidence' && <ComplianceEvidenceTab evidenceDocuments={complianceCase.evidenceDocuments} />}
                        {activeTab === 'auditLog' && <ComplianceAuditLogTab auditLog={complianceCase.auditLog} />}
                        {activeTab === 'resolution' && <ComplianceResolutionTab complianceCase={complianceCase} onSave={handleSaveCase} isLoading={isLoading} />}
                    </div>
                </div>
            ) : null}

            <ConfirmDialog
                isOpen={isConfirmDeleteModalOpen}
                onClose={() => setIsConfirmDeleteModalOpen(false)}
                onConfirm={handleDeleteCase}
                title="Confirm Deletion"
                message={`Are you sure you want to delete compliance case "${complianceCase?.caseNumber}"? This action cannot be undone.`}
                confirmText="Delete"
                isDestructive
            />
            <Modal isOpen={isEditModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)} title={`Edit Case: ${complianceCase?.caseNumber}`} size="md">
                {complianceCase && <ComplianceCaseForm initialCase={complianceCase} onSave={handleSaveCase} onCancel={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)} isLoading={isLoading} />}
            </Modal>
        </Modal>
    );
};

interface ComplianceActionItemsTabProps {
    caseId: string;
    actionItems: ActionItem[];
    onActionItemUpdate: (caseId: string, updatedActionItem: ActionItem) => void;
}
export const ComplianceActionItemsTab: React.FC<ComplianceActionItemsTabProps> = ({ caseId, actionItems, onActionItemUpdate }) => {
    const [isAddActionItemModalOpen, setIsAddActionItemModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const { formData: newActionItem, handleChange, setFormData, resetForm } = useForm<Partial<ActionItem>>({
        description: '', assignedTo: mockCurrentUser.name, dueDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], status: 'Open'
    });

    const handleSaveNewActionItem = useCallback(() => {
        if (!newActionItem.description || !newActionItem.assignedTo || !newActionItem.dueDate) return;
        const savedItem: ActionItem = {
            id: generateUUID(),
            description: newActionItem.description,
            assignedTo: newActionItem.assignedTo,
            dueDate: newActionItem.dueDate,
            status: newActionItem.status || 'Open',
            completionDate: newActionItem.status === 'Completed' ? new Date().toISOString() : undefined,
            notes: newActionItem.notes,
        };
        // This should trigger an update to the parent compliance case
        // For simplicity, we'll just log and reset for now.
        console.log('New action item:', savedItem);
        // A real implementation would call an API to add this action item to the case
        // and then update the complianceCase state in the parent.
        // For now, we simulate success and reset.
        resetForm();
        setIsAddActionItemModalOpen(false);
        // A real app would add this to the case's actionItems and call onActionItemUpdate
    }, [newActionItem, resetForm]);

    const handleUpdateStatus = useCallback((item: ActionItem, newStatus: ActionItem['status']) => {
        const updatedItem = { ...item, status: newStatus, completionDate: newStatus === 'Completed' ? new Date().toISOString() : undefined };
        onActionItemUpdate(caseId, updatedItem);
    }, [caseId, onActionItemUpdate]);

    const statusOptions = useMemo(() => Object.values(ActionItem['status']).map(s => ({ value: s, label: s })), []);
    const assignedToOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'Compliance Officer A', label: 'Compliance Officer A' },
        { value: 'Analyst B', label: 'Analyst B' },
    ]), []);

    return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">
                <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Action Items ({actionItems.length})</h4>
                <Button onClick={() => setIsAddActionItemModalOpen(true)} size="sm">
                    <PlusIcon className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /> Add Action Item
                </Button>
            </div>
            {actionItems.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-gray-400">No action items for this case.</p>
            ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-sm text-left text-gray-400">
                        <thead className="text-xs text-gray-300 uppercase bg-gray-900/30">
                            <tr>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Description</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Assigned To</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Due Date</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Status</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Actions</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            {actionItems.map(item => (
                                <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-800/50">
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-white">{item.description}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{item.assignedTo}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatDate(item.dueDate)}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                        <span className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeColor(item.status)}`}>
                                            {item.status}
                                        </span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                        {item.status !== 'Completed' && (
                                            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(item, 'Completed')}>
                                                <CheckCircleIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                                            </Button>
                                        )}
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            ))}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            )}
            <Modal isOpen={isAddActionItemModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsAddActionItemModalOpen(false)} title="Add New Action Item">
                <form onSubmit={handleSaveNewActionItem} className="space-y-4">
                    <InputField label="Description" id="description" value={newActionItem.description || ''} onChange={handleChange} required />
                    <FilterSelect<string>
                        label="Assigned To"
                        options={assignedToOptions}
                        selectedValue={newActionItem.assignedTo || ''}
                        onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, assignedTo: val || '' }))}
                        allowClear={false}
                    />
                    <InputField label="Due Date" id="dueDate" type="date" value={newActionItem.dueDate?.split('T')[0] || ''} onChange={handleChange} required />
                    <InputField label="Notes" id="notes" value={newActionItem.notes || ''} onChange={handleChange} multiline />
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setIsAddActionItemModalOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
                        <Button type="submit" variant="primary">Add Item</Button>
                    </div>
                </form>
            </Modal>
        </div>
    );
};

                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeColor(doc.category)}`}>{doc.category}</span>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
        )}
    </div>
);

interface ComplianceAuditLogTabProps {
    auditLog: ActivityLogEntry[];
}
export const ComplianceAuditLogTab: React.FC<ComplianceAuditLogTabProps> = ({ auditLog }) => {
    const sortedLog = [...auditLog].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
    return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
            <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">Audit Log ({auditLog.length})</h4>
            {auditLog.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-gray-400">No audit log entries.</p>
            ) : (
                <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-2">
                    {sortedLog.map(log => (
                        <div key={log.id} className="p-3 bg-gray-800/70 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 mb-3">
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                <span className="font-semibold text-white">{log.action}</span>
                                <span>{formatDateTime(log.timestamp)} by <span className="text-indigo-300">{log.userName}</span></span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">{log.details}</p>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

interface ComplianceResolutionTabProps {
    complianceCase: ComplianceCaseExtended;
    onSave: (caseData: ComplianceCaseExtended) => void;
    isLoading: boolean;
}
export const ComplianceResolutionTab: React.FC<ComplianceResolutionTabProps> = ({ complianceCase, onSave, isLoading }) => {
    const { formData, handleChange, setFormData } = useForm(complianceCase.resolutionDetails || {
        resolutionDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        resolutionSummary: '',
        outcome: 'No Violation',
        regulatoryReportFiled: false,
    });
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

    useEffect(() => {
        if (complianceCase.resolutionDetails) {
            setFormData(complianceCase.resolutionDetails);
        } else {
            setFormData({
                resolutionDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
                resolutionSummary: '',
                outcome: 'No Violation',
                regulatoryReportFiled: false,
            });
        }
    }, [complianceCase.resolutionDetails, setFormData]);

    const validate = useCallback(() => {
        const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
        if (!formData.resolutionSummary || formData.resolutionSummary.trim() === '') newErrors.resolutionSummary = 'Resolution summary is required.';
        setErrors(newErrors);
        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
    }, [formData]);

    const handleSaveResolution = useCallback((e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!validate()) return;
        const updatedCase = {
            ...complianceCase,
            resolutionDetails: formData as ComplianceCaseExtended['resolutionDetails'],
            status: 'Closed' as ComplianceCaseExtended['status'], // Automatically close on resolution save
        };
        onSave(updatedCase);
    }, [complianceCase, formData, onSave, validate]);

    const outcomeOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'Compliant', label: 'Compliant (Remediated)' },
        { value: 'Non-Compliant - Remediation', label: 'Non-Compliant (Remediation Required)' },
        { value: 'No Violation', label: 'No Violation Found' },
    ]), []);

    const isClosed = complianceCase.status === 'Closed';

    return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
            <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">Resolution Details</h4>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveResolution}>
                <InputField label="Resolution Date" id="resolutionDate" type="date" value={formData.resolutionDate?.split('T')[0] || ''} onChange={handleChange} readOnly={isClosed} />
                <FilterSelect<ComplianceCaseExtended['resolutionDetails']['outcome']>
                    label="Outcome"
                    options={outcomeOptions}
                    selectedValue={formData.outcome || 'No Violation'}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, outcome: val || 'No Violation' }))}
                    allowClear={false}
                    disabled={isClosed}
                />
                <InputField label="Resolution Summary" id="resolutionSummary" value={formData.resolutionSummary || ''} onChange={handleChange} multiline rows={4} required error={errors.resolutionSummary} readOnly={isClosed} />
                <div className="mb-4 flex items-center">
                    <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        id="regulatoryReportFiled"
                        name="regulatoryReportFiled"
                        checked={formData.regulatoryReportFiled || false}
                        onChange={handleChange}
                        disabled={isClosed}
                        className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 bg-gray-700 border-gray-600 rounded focus:ring-indigo-500"
                    />
                    <label htmlFor="regulatoryReportFiled" className="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-300">Regulatory Report Filed</label>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                    {!isClosed && (
                        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={isLoading}>
                            {isLoading ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Resolution & Close Case'}
                        </Button>
                    )}
                    {isClosed && <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">Case already closed.</p>}
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    );
};

/**
 * @interface ComplianceDashboardStats
 * @description Represents key statistics for the compliance dashboard.
 */
export interface ComplianceDashboardStats {
    totalCases: number;
    openCases: number;
    casesUnderInvestigation: number;
    casesDueSoon: number; // e.g., next 7 days
    overdueCases: number;
    criticalPriorityCases: number;
    casesByStatus: { status: ComplianceCaseExtended['status']; count: number }[];
    casesByPriority: { priority: RiskLevel; count: number }[];
    casesByCategory: { reason: string; count: number }[];
}

/**
 * @function calculateComplianceDashboardStats
 * @description Calculates dashboard statistics from a list of compliance cases.
 */
export const calculateComplianceDashboardStats = (cases: ComplianceCaseExtended[]): ComplianceDashboardStats => {
    const totalCases = cases.length;
    const openCases = cases.filter(c => c.status !== 'Closed').length;
    const casesUnderInvestigation = cases.filter(c => c.status === 'Investigation').length;

    const now = new Date();
    const next7Days = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const casesDueSoon = cases.filter(c =>
        c.status !== 'Closed' && new Date(c.dueDate) > now && new Date(c.dueDate) <= next7Days
    ).length;
    const overdueCases = cases.filter(c =>
        c.status !== 'Closed' && new Date(c.dueDate) < now
    ).length;

    const criticalPriorityCases = cases.filter(c => c.priority === RiskLevel.Critical).length;

    const casesByStatusMap = cases.reduce((acc, c) => {
        acc[c.status] = (acc[c.status] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
    }, {} as Record<ComplianceCaseExtended['status'], number>);
    const casesByStatus = Object.entries(casesByStatusMap).map(([status, count]) => ({ status: status as ComplianceCaseExtended['status'], count }));

    const casesByPriorityMap = cases.reduce((acc, c) => {
        acc[c.priority] = (acc[c.priority] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
    }, {} as Record<RiskLevel, number>);
    const casesByPriority = Object.entries(casesByPriorityMap).map(([priority, count]) => ({ priority: priority as RiskLevel, count }));

    const casesByCategoryMap = cases.reduce((acc, c) => {
        acc[c.reason] = (acc[c.reason] || 0) + 1;
        return acc;
    }, {} as Record<string, number>);
    const casesByCategory = Object.entries(casesByCategoryMap).map(([reason, count]) => ({ reason, count }));

    return {
        totalCases,
        openCases,
        casesUnderInvestigation,
        casesDueSoon,
        overdueCases,
        criticalPriorityCases,
        casesByStatus,
        casesByPriority,
        casesByCategory,
    };
};

}

// Main ComplianceView Component
const ComplianceView: React.FC = () => {
    // DataContext is original - we'll simulate the extended data here for this file
    const context = useContext(DataContext);
    const [allComplianceCases, setAllComplianceCases] = useState<ComplianceCaseExtended[]>([]);
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<'dashboard' | 'cases' | 'rules' | 'updates'>('dashboard');

    const [filters, setFilters] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
    const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<string>('lastUpdated');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
    const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);

    const [selectedCaseId, setSelectedCaseId] = useState<string | null>(selectedCaseId);
    const [isCaseDetailModalOpen, setIsCaseDetailModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [isAddCaseModalOpen, setIsAddCaseModalOpen] = useState(false);

    // Notifications (re-using from AnomalyDetectionView)
    const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);
    const addNotification = useCallback((message: string, type: Notification['type'], timeout: number = 5000) => {
      const id = generateUUID();
      setNotifications((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type, timeout }]);
    }, []);
    const dismissNotification = useCallback((id: string) => {
      setNotifications((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
    }, []);

    const fetchCases = useCallback(async () => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.getComplianceCases(filters, currentPage, itemsPerPage, sortBy, sortOrder);
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setAllComplianceCases(result.data.cases);
                setTotalItems(result.data.total);
            } else {
                setError(result.error || 'Failed to fetch compliance cases.');
                addNotification(result.error || 'Failed to fetch compliance cases.', 'error');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
            addNotification(`Error fetching cases: ${err.message}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [filters, currentPage, itemsPerPage, sortBy, sortOrder, addNotification]);

    useEffect(() => {
        fetchCases();
    }, [fetchCases]);

    const handleFilterChange = useCallback((key: string, value: any) => {
        setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
        setCurrentPage(1); // Reset to first page on filter change
    }, []);

    const handleSortChange = useCallback((field: string) => {
        setSortBy(field);
        setSortOrder(prev => (prev === 'asc' && field === sortBy ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
    }, [sortBy]);

    const handlePageChange = useCallback((page: number) => {
        setCurrentPage(page);
    }, []);

    const handleEditCase = useCallback((updatedCase: ComplianceCaseExtended) => {
        setAllComplianceCases(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === updatedCase.id ? updatedCase : c));
        addNotification(`Case ${updatedCase.caseNumber} updated successfully!`, 'success');
    }, [addNotification]);

    const handleSaveNewCase = useCallback(async (newCase: ComplianceCaseExtended) => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.addComplianceCase(newCase);
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setAllComplianceCases(prev => [result.data, ...prev]);
                setTotalItems(prev => prev + 1);
                addNotification(`Compliance case ${result.data.caseNumber} created.`, 'success');
                setIsAddCaseModalOpen(false);
            } else {
                throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to add new case.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
            addNotification(`Error adding case: ${err.message}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [addNotification]);

    const handleDeleteCase = useCallback(async (caseId: string) => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.deleteComplianceCase(caseId);
            if (result.success) {
                setAllComplianceCases(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== caseId));
                setTotalItems(prev => prev - 1);
                addNotification(`Compliance case ${caseId} deleted.`, 'success');
            } else {
                throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to delete case.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
            addNotification(`Error deleting case: ${err.message}`, 'error');
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [addNotification]);

    const handleStatusUpdate = useCallback((caseId: string, newStatus: ComplianceCaseExtended['status']) => {
        setAllComplianceCases(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === caseId ? { ...c, status: newStatus, lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString() } : c));
        addNotification(`Case ${caseId.substring(0,8)} status updated to ${newStatus}.`, 'info');
    }, [addNotification]);

    const handleActionItemUpdate = useCallback((caseId: string, updatedActionItem: ActionItem) => {
        setAllComplianceCases(prev => prev.map(c => {
            if (c.id === caseId) {
                const newActionItems = c.actionItems.map(item => item.id === updatedActionItem.id ? updatedActionItem : item);
                return { ...c, actionItems: newActionItems, lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString() };
            }
            return c;
        }));
        addNotification(`Action item for case ${caseId.substring(0,8)} updated.`, 'info');
    }, [addNotification]);


    const dashboardStats = useMemo(() => calculateComplianceDashboardStats(allComplianceCases), [allComplianceCases]);

    const handleViewCasesFromDashboard = useCallback((statusFilter?: ComplianceCaseExtended['status'] | 'all', priorityFilter?: RiskLevel | 'all') => {
        const newFilters: Record<string, any> = {};
        if (statusFilter && statusFilter !== 'all') {
            newFilters.status = statusFilter;
        }
        if (priorityFilter && priorityFilter !== 'all') {
            newFilters.priority = priorityFilter;
        }
        setFilters(newFilters);
        setActiveView('cases');
        setCurrentPage(1);
    }, []);

    const complianceCaseStatusOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'All', label: 'All Statuses' },
        ...Object.values(ComplianceCaseExtended['status']).map(s => ({ value: s, label: s }))
    ]), []);

    const compliancePriorityOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'All', label: 'All Priorities' },
        ...Object.values(RiskLevel).map(p => ({ value: p, label: p }))
    ]), []);

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-white tracking-wider">Compliance Center</h2>

            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                    <Button onClick={() => setActiveView('dashboard')} variant={activeView === 'dashboard' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} size="sm">
                        Dashboard
                    </Button>
                    <Button onClick={() => setActiveView('cases')} variant={activeView === 'cases' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} size="sm">
                        Cases
                    </Button>
                    <Button onClick={() => setActiveView('rules')} variant={activeView === 'rules' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} size="sm">
                        Ruleset
                    </Button>
                    <Button onClick={() => setActiveView('updates')} variant={activeView === 'updates' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} size="sm">
                        Regulatory Updates
                    </Button>
                </div>
                <Button onClick={() => setIsAddCaseModalOpen(true)} variant="primary">
                    <PlusIcon className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /> New Case
                </Button>
            </div>

            {activeView === 'dashboard' && (
                <ComplianceDashboardOverview
                    stats={dashboardStats}
                    onViewCases={handleViewCasesFromDashboard}
                    onViewRules={() => setActiveView('rules')}
                    onViewRegulatoryUpdates={() => setActiveView('updates')}
                />
            )}

            {activeView === 'cases' && (
                <Card title="Compliance Cases">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                        <InputField
                            label="Search Cases"
                            id="searchTerm"
                            value={filters.searchTerm || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('searchTerm', e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Search by ID, reason, description..."
                            className="flex-grow max-w-sm"
                        />
                        <FilterSelect<ComplianceCaseExtended['status'] | 'All'>
                            label="Status"
                            options={complianceCaseStatusOptions}
                            selectedValue={filters.status || 'All'}
                            onChange={(val) => handleFilterChange('status', val)}
                        />
                         <FilterSelect<RiskLevel | 'All'>
                            label="Priority"
                            options={compliancePriorityOptions}
                            selectedValue={filters.priority || 'All'}
                            onChange={(val) => handleFilterChange('priority', val)}
                        />
                        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setFilters({})}>Clear Filters</Button>
                    </div>

                    {isLoading ? (
                        <LoadingSpinner />
                    ) : error ? (
                        <p className="text-red-400">{error}</p>
                    ) : allComplianceCases.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-gray-400 italic">No compliance cases found matching your criteria.</p>
                    ) : (
                        <>
                            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left text-gray-400">
                                    <thead className="text-xs text-gray-300 uppercase bg-gray-900/30">
                                        <tr>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSortChange('caseNumber')}>
                                                Case ID {sortBy === 'caseNumber' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'â' : 'â')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSortChange('reason')}>
                                                Reason {sortBy === 'reason' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'â' : 'â')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Entity</th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSortChange('openedDate')}>
                                                Opened {sortBy === 'openedDate' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'â' : 'â')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSortChange('dueDate')}>
                                                Due Date {sortBy === 'dueDate' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'â' : 'â')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSortChange('priority')}>
                                                Priority {sortBy === 'priority' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'â' : 'â')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSortChange('status')}>
                                                Status {sortBy === 'status' && (sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'â' : 'â')}
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Assigned To</th>
                                            <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Action</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody>
                                        {allComplianceCases.map(c => (
                                            <tr key={c.id} className="border-b border-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-800/50">
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4 font-mono text-white">{c.caseNumber}</td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-white">{c.reason}</td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4 font-mono text-xs">{c.entityType}<br/>{c.entityId}</td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatDate(c.openedDate)}</td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                                    <span className={`${new Date(c.dueDate) < new Date() && c.status !== 'Closed' ? 'text-red-400 font-semibold' : 'text-gray-300'}`}>
                                                        {formatDate(c.dueDate)}
                                                    </span>
                                                </td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4"><span className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeColor(c.priority)}`}>{c.priority}</span></td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4"><span className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeColor(c.status)}`}>{c.status}</span></td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4">{c.assignedTo}</td>
                                                <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                                    <button onClick={() => { setSelectedCaseId(c.id); setIsCaseDetailModalOpen(true); }} className="text-xs text-indigo-300 hover:underline">View Details</button>
                                                </td>
                                            </tr>
                                        ))}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                            <Paginator currentPage={currentPage} totalPages={Math.ceil(totalItems / itemsPerPage)} onPageChange={handlePageChange} itemsPerPage={itemsPerPage} totalItems={totalItems} />
                        </>
                    )}
                </Card>
            )}

            {activeView === 'rules' && <ComplianceRulesetView />}
            {activeView === 'updates' && <RegulatoryUpdatesView />}

            <Modal isOpen={isAddCaseModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsAddCaseModalOpen(false)} title="Create New Compliance Case" size="md">
                <ComplianceCaseForm onSave={handleSaveNewCase} onCancel={() => setIsAddCaseModalOpen(false)} isLoading={isLoading} />
            </Modal>

            {selectedCaseId && (
                <ComplianceCaseDetailModal
                    isOpen={isCaseDetailModalOpen}
                    onClose={() => setIsCaseDetailModalOpen(false)}
                    caseId={selectedCaseId}
                    onEdit={handleEditCase}
                    onDelete={handleDeleteCase}
                    onStatusChange={handleStatusUpdate}
                    onActionItemUpdate={handleActionItemUpdate}
                />
            )}
            <NotificationContainer notifications={notifications} onDismissNotification={dismissNotification} />
        </div>
    );
};

export default ComplianceView;

// --- Compliance Ruleset View Component ---
export const ComplianceRulesetView: React.FC = () => {
    const [rules, setRules] = useState<ComplianceRule[]>([]);
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState<ComplianceRule['category'] | 'All'>('All');
    const [isAddRuleModalOpen, setIsAddRuleModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [editingRule, setEditingRule] = useState<ComplianceRule | null>(null);
    const [isConfirmDeleteRuleModalOpen, setIsConfirmDeleteRuleModalOpen] = useState(false);
    const [ruleToDelete, setRuleToDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const fetchRules = useCallback(async () => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.getComplianceRules({ searchTerm, category: filterCategory === 'All' ? undefined : filterCategory });
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setRules(result.data);
            } else {
                setError(result.error || 'Failed to fetch compliance rules.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [searchTerm, filterCategory]);

    useEffect(() => {
        fetchRules();
    }, [fetchRules]);

    const handleSaveRule = useCallback(async (ruleData: ComplianceRule) => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            if (editingRule) {
                await apiService.updateComplianceRule(ruleData.id, ruleData);
            } else {
                await apiService.addComplianceRule(ruleData);
            }
            fetchRules();
            setIsAddRuleModalOpen(false);
            setEditingRule(null);
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [editingRule, fetchRules]);

    const handleDeleteRule = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!ruleToDelete) return;
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
            await apiService.deleteComplianceRule(ruleToDelete);
            fetchRules();
            setIsConfirmDeleteRuleModalOpen(false);
            setRuleToDelete(null);
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [ruleToDelete, fetchRules]);

    const ruleCategoryOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'All', label: 'All Categories' },
        ...Object.values(ComplianceRule['category']).map(c => ({ value: c, label: c }))
    ]), []);

    return (
        <Card title="Compliance Ruleset">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                <InputField
                    label="Search Rules"
                    id="ruleSearchTerm"
                    value={searchTerm}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search rules..."
                    className="flex-grow max-w-sm"
                />
                <FilterSelect<ComplianceRule['category'] | 'All'>
                    label="Category"
                    options={ruleCategoryOptions}
                    selectedValue={filterCategory}
                    onChange={(val) => setFilterCategory(val || 'All')}
                />
                <Button onClick={() => { setIsAddRuleModalOpen(true); setEditingRule(null); }} variant="primary" className="ml-auto">
                    <PlusIcon className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /> Add New Rule
                </Button>
            </div>

            {isLoading ? (
                <LoadingSpinner />
            ) : error ? (
                <p className="text-red-400">{error}</p>
            ) : rules.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-gray-400 italic">No compliance rules found.</p>
            ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-sm text-left text-gray-400">
                        <thead className="text-xs text-gray-300 uppercase bg-gray-900/30">
                            <tr>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Rule Name</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Category</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Criteria</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Severity</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Active</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Last Updated</th>
                                <th scope="col" className="px-6 py-3">Actions</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            {rules.map(rule => (
                                <tr key={rule.id} className="border-b border-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-800/50">
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-white">{rule.name}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{rule.category}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4 truncate max-w-xs">{rule.criteria}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><span className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeColor(rule.severity)}`}>{rule.severity}</span></td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                        {rule.active ? <CheckCircleIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-green-500" /> : <XCircleIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-red-500" />}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatDate(rule.lastUpdated)}</td>
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                                        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="mr-2" onClick={() => { setEditingRule(rule); setIsAddRuleModalOpen(true); }}>Edit</Button>
                                        <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => { setRuleToDelete(rule.id); setIsConfirmDeleteRuleModalOpen(true); }}>Delete</Button>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            ))}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            )}
            <Modal isOpen={isAddRuleModalOpen} onClose={() => { setIsAddRuleModalOpen(false); setEditingRule(null); }} title={editingRule ? "Edit Compliance Rule" : "Add New Compliance Rule"} size="md">
                <ComplianceRuleForm initialRule={editingRule || undefined} onSave={handleSaveRule} onCancel={() => { setIsAddRuleModalOpen(false); setEditingRule(null); }} isLoading={isLoading} />
            </Modal>
            <ConfirmDialog
                isOpen={isConfirmDeleteRuleModalOpen}
                onClose={() => setIsConfirmDeleteRuleModalOpen(false)}
                onConfirm={handleDeleteRule}
                title="Confirm Rule Deletion"
                message="Are you sure you want to delete this compliance rule? This action cannot be undone."
                confirmText="Delete"
                isDestructive
            />
        </Card>
    );
};

interface ComplianceRuleFormProps {
    initialRule?: ComplianceRule;
    onSave: (ruleData: ComplianceRule) => void;
    onCancel: () => void;
    isLoading: boolean;
}

export const ComplianceRuleForm: React.FC<ComplianceRuleFormProps> = ({ initialRule, onSave, onCancel, isLoading }) => {
    const isEditing = !!initialRule;
    const { formData, handleChange, setFormData } = useForm<Partial<ComplianceRule>>(initialRule || {
        name: '', category: 'AML', description: '', criteria: '', severity: RiskLevel.Medium, active: true, owner: mockCurrentUser.name, version: 1
    });
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

    const validate = useCallback(() => {
        const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
        if (!formData.name || formData.name.trim() === '') newErrors.name = 'Rule Name is required.';
        if (!formData.category) newErrors.category = 'Category is required.';
        if (!formData.criteria || formData.criteria.trim() === '') newErrors.criteria = 'Criteria is required.';
        setErrors(newErrors);
        return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
    }, [formData]);

    const handleSubmit = useCallback((e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!validate()) return;
        const ruleToSave: ComplianceRule = {
            ...(initialRule || {}),
            id: initialRule?.id || generateUUID(),
            lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
            owner: formData.owner || mockCurrentUser.name,
            version: initialRule?.version || 1, // Auto increment if edited in real app
            ...formData,
        } as ComplianceRule;
        onSave(ruleToSave);
    }, [formData, initialRule, onSave, validate]);

    const categoryOptions = useMemo(() => Object.values(ComplianceRule['category']).map(c => ({ value: c, label: c })), []);
    const severityOptions = useMemo(() => Object.values(RiskLevel).map(p => ({ value: p, label: p })), []);

    return (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <InputField label="Rule Name" id="name" value={formData.name || ''} onChange={handleChange} required error={errors.name} />
            <FilterSelect<ComplianceRule['category']>
                label="Category"
                options={categoryOptions}
                selectedValue={formData.category || 'AML'}
                onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, category: val || 'AML' }))}
                allowClear={false}
            />
            <InputField label="Description" id="description" value={formData.description || ''} onChange={handleChange} multiline rows={3} />
            <InputField label="Criteria" id="criteria" value={formData.criteria || ''} onChange={handleChange} multiline rows={3} required error={errors.criteria} />
            <FilterSelect<RiskLevel>
                label="Severity"
                options={severityOptions}
                selectedValue={formData.severity || RiskLevel.Medium}
                onChange={(val) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, severity: val || RiskLevel.Medium }))}
                allowClear={false}
            />
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center">
                <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    id="active"
                    name="active"
                    checked={formData.active || false}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                    className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 bg-gray-700 border-gray-600 rounded focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
                <label htmlFor="active" className="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-300">Active Rule</label>
            </div>
            <InputField label="Owner" id="owner" value={formData.owner || ''} onChange={handleChange} />
            <InputField label="Regulatory Reference" id="regulatoryReference" value={formData.regulatoryReference || ''} onChange={handleChange} />
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center">
                <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    id="triggerAutomation"
                    name="triggerAutomation"
                    checked={formData.triggerAutomation || false}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                    className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 bg-gray-700 border-gray-600 rounded focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
                <label htmlFor="triggerAutomation" className="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-300">Trigger Automation</label>
            </div>
            <InputField label="Version" id="version" type="number" value={formData.version || 1} onChange={handleChange} readOnly={true} />
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel} disabled={isLoading}>Cancel</Button>
                <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={isLoading}>
                    {isLoading ? 'Saving...' : (isEditing ? 'Update Rule' : 'Create Rule')}
                </Button>
            </div>
        </form>
    );
};

// --- Regulatory Updates View Component ---
export const RegulatoryUpdatesView: React.FC = () => {
    const [updates, setUpdates] = useState<RegulatoryUpdate[]>([]);
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    const [filterAgency, setFilterAgency] = useState<string | 'All'>('All');
    const [filterJurisdiction, setFilterJurisdiction] = useState<string | 'All'>('All');
    const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<RegulatoryUpdate['status'] | 'All'>('All');

    const fetchUpdates = useCallback(async () => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const result = await apiService.getRegulatoryUpdates({
                searchTerm,
                agency: filterAgency === 'All' ? undefined : filterAgency,
                jurisdiction: filterJurisdiction === 'All' ? undefined : filterJurisdiction,
                status: filterStatus === 'All' ? undefined : filterStatus,
            });
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                setUpdates(result.data);
            } else {
                setError(result.error || 'Failed to fetch regulatory updates.');
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            setError(err.message);
        } finally {
            setIsLoading(false);
        }
    }, [searchTerm, filterAgency, filterJurisdiction, filterStatus]);

    useEffect(() => {
        fetchUpdates();
    }, [fetchUpdates]);

    const agencyOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'All', label: 'All Agencies' },
        ...Array.from(new Set(updates.map(u => u.agency))).filter(Boolean).map(a => ({ value: a, label: a }))
    ]), [updates]);

    const jurisdictionOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'All', label: 'All Jurisdictions' },
        ...Array.from(new Set(updates.map(u => u.jurisdiction))).filter(Boolean).map(j => ({ value: j, label: j }))
    ]), [updates]);

    const statusOptions = useMemo(() => ([
        { value: 'All', label: 'All Statuses' },
        ...Object.values(RegulatoryUpdate['status']).map(s => ({ value: s, label: s }))
    ]), []);

    return (
        <Card title="Regulatory Updates">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                <InputField
                    label="Search Updates"
                    id="updateSearchTerm"
                    value={searchTerm}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search titles, summaries..."
                    className="flex-grow max-w-sm"
                />
                <FilterSelect<string | 'All'>
                    label="Agency"
                    options={agencyOptions}
                    selectedValue={filterAgency}
                    onChange={(val) => setFilterAgency(val || 'All')}
                />
                <FilterSelect<string | 'All'>
                    label="Jurisdiction"
                    options={jurisdictionOptions}
                    selectedValue={filterJurisdiction}
                    onChange={(val) => setFilterJurisdiction(val || 'All')}
                />
                <FilterSelect<RegulatoryUpdate['status'] | 'All'>
                    label="Status"
                    options={statusOptions}
                    selectedValue={filterStatus}
                    onChange={(val) => setFilterStatus(val || 'All')}
                />
                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setSearchTerm(''); setFilterAgency('All'); setFilterJurisdiction('All'); setFilterStatus('All'); }}>Clear Filters</Button>
            </div>

            {isLoading ? (
                <LoadingSpinner />
            ) : error ? (
                <p className="text-red-400">{error}</p>
            ) : updates.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-gray-400 italic">No regulatory updates found.</p>
            ) : (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                    {updates.map(update => (
                        <div key={update.id} className="bg-gray-800/70 p-4 rounded-lg border border-gray-700">
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                                <h5 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{update.title}</h5>
                                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${getStatusBadgeColor(update.status)}`}>{update.status}</span>
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">
                                {update.agency} - {update.jurisdiction} | Effective: {formatDate(update.effectiveDate)}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-300 italic">{update.summary}</p>
                            {update.documentUrl && (
                                <a href={update.documentUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-indigo-400 hover:underline text-xs mt-2 inline-block">
                                    View Official Document
                                </a>
                            )}
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-2">
                                {update.relatedRules.map(ruleId => <span key={ruleId} className="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs bg-gray-700 text-gray-200 rounded-full">{ruleId}</span>)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
            )}
        </Card>
    );
};
